title: Her bicycle at Gully's
logline: Gully's daughter's bicycle leaning on the shack in May, thirteen, a basket with a school bag in it, the ramp beside it. The page draws it before the August girl's bicycle two years on and doesn't know it's a pair yet.

panels.composition: A girl's bicycle leaning against a shingle shack beside a plank ramp, a wire basket holding a school bag, May light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a girl's bicycle leaning against a shingle bait shack beside a plank ramp with a wire basket holding a school bag, May light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A pair it doesn't know yet.
